settings.description_override: The Delphine moves easily from the first coffee to the last table of the evening. Textured canvas and burnished leather give its compact shape a warm, collected character, while rolled handles and gold-tone fittings lend a little formality. A bag for the woman whose plans rarely end where they began.
settings.fact_detail: Made by artisans with 10 years of experience

settings.heading: Details
settings.content: Rolled top handles and a detachable long strap offer different ways to carry the Delphine. Leather side gussets, curved corner patches and low-hanging slotted gold-tone fittings define the exterior. Approximate dimensions are 25 × 22 × 14 cm (W × H × D).

settings.heading: Care
settings.content: Spot-clean the canvas with a soft, barely damp cloth. Wipe the leather with a dry cloth, keeping moisture away from the edges and fittings. Let the bag dry naturally and store loosely filled, away from direct sunlight.

settings.heading: Shipping & delivery
settings.content: Please allow 10 days from your order to dispatch. Delivery time is additional and varies by destination. You will receive tracking details when your order ships. See our shipping policy for delivery information.

settings.heading: Returns
settings.content: Returns are accepted within 30 days of delivery for unused items in their original packaging with tags attached. To arrange a return, contact customerservice@velantrafashion.com. See our return policy for full conditions.
